description: Who posts the gate's Origin check run (tower/gate). client: the Origin client with the session's credential, which Origin refuses unless it is an oit_ installation token. control: the control plane's POST /v1/check-run, which mints the installation token from the Origin app's key it alone holds (ORIGIN_APP_PRIVATE_KEY) and answers 503 while that secret is absent (D-299). port: the engine's port (POST /v1/check-run), posted by the live service on AWS with the app's key from Parameter Store (/tower/origin/factory-app-signing-key; CHECK-RUN-AWS), the Worker off the path.
